name: soundora-backend
postStartCommand: if [ ! -f /tmp/uvicorn.pid ] || ! kill -0 "$(cat /tmp/uvicorn.pid)" 2>/dev/null; then cd /workspaces/soundora-backend && nohup python -m uvicorn main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 > /tmp/uvicorn.log 2>&1 & echo $! > /tmp/uvicorn.pid; fi; echo "postStart ran $(date -u +%FT%TZ)" >> /tmp/poststart.log
